37:

39: 		t.Fatal("expected non-nil recording service")

45: 	if thumbnailSvc == nil {
46: 		t.Fatal("expected non-nil thumbnail service")
47: 	}

49: 		t.Fatalf("thumbnail service type = %T, want *thumbnail.Service", thumbnailSvc)

51: 
52: 	if settingsSvc == nil {
53: 		t.Fatal("expected non-nil settings service")
54: 	}
55: 	if _, ok := any(settingsSvc).(*settings.Service); !ok {
56: 		t.Fatalf("settings service type = %T, want *settings.Service", settingsSvc)

58: 
59: 	if aiFactory == nil {
60: 		t.Fatal("expected non-nil AI factory")
